description: This file is a shell script used for performance testing git clone operations, specifically focusing on the speed of cloning with a reference repository. It includes setup for test repositories, performing clone operations, and measuring performance.

methods.name: test_perf_default_repo
methods.description: Sets up the default performance test repository.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test that is expected to succeed with a given description.

methods.name: test_perf
methods.description: Runs a performance test with a specified label.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
